core_obligations: Reduce to the case of a complex that is zero outside the interval given by the amplitude hypothesis (proof lines 17428-17440).
Construct the resolution degree by degree by choosing projective modules mapping onto the successive cohomology groups and lifting the differentials (proof lines 17440-17470).
Use the boundedness of the amplitude to show that the construction stops, giving a bounded complex of finite projective modules resolving the original one (proof lines 17470-17480).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a bounded representative (proof lines 17428-17440).
Build the resolution degree by degree (proof lines 17440-17470).
difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises complexes of bounded projective amplitude through the existence of a resolution by a bounded complex of finite projective modules, and the proof is a 53-line argument that first reduces to a bounded representative of the complex and then constructs the resolution degree by degree. At each degree it chooses a finitely generated projective module mapping onto the cohomology in that degree and lifts the differential, and it uses the boundedness of the amplitude to show that the construction terminates. The construction and the termination argument are the two parts of the proof and both are displayed.
